Name: Sebastian's Bong - Content Patcher
Author: caomicc
Description:
A content patch mod to re-add Sebastian's bong back into the game! ﻿Now includes multiple colors!
Pick from a beaker style, blue (original), glass, green, purple, or red! 

How to install:
[list=1]
[*]Unzip the zip file and add to Mods folder ([i]see the [url=http://https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Find_your_game_folder]stardew valley modding wiki[/url]﻿ for help![/i])
[*]Open the config.sjon file and change the ﻿color value to be rather a ﻿beaker, blue, glass, green, orange, purple, or red
[*]Play!
[/list] ﻿

Inspired by ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/58?tab=description]Sebastian's Bong Restored[/url]﻿.

Only edits a portion of townInteriors so it [i]shouldn't[/i] conflict with any other mods. Let me know if it does!
